biography: Cadú Pasetti, a name synonymous with flair and fearless driving, hails from the sun-baked streets of Ribeirão Preto, Brazil. His journey began not on the polished asphalt of a racetrack, but on the dusty dirt roads outside his family's auto repair shop. He learned the delicate dance of throttle control and weight transfer dismantling and rebuilding engines alongside his father. Cadú's formal racing career ignited when he caught the eye of a Copa Montana scout while dominating local go-kart circuits, his raw talent impossible to ignore. A defining moment came at Interlagos in 2018; starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying mishap, Cadú carved his way through the field, overtaking three cars in the final corner to snatch a podium finish. Now, at the peak of his abilities, Cadú remains a formidable force in the Copa Montana, chasing championships and living life with the same audacious spirit he displays on the track. He is determined to cement his legacy as one of Brazil's greats, entertaining fans and competitors alike.
drivingStyle: Cadú is an aggressive, instinctive driver known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to push the limits of his car. He possesses exceptional car control, allowing him to recover from slides and maintain momentum through challenging corners. While his aggressive style sometimes leads to mistakes, it also allows him to execute daring overtakes that few others would attempt. He's less meticulous about tire management, preferring to attack from the start, relying on raw pace and instinct rather than strategy.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days. Ricardo is Cadú's polar opposite – calculating and consistent, leading to frequent clashes over race strategy and track position.
A fierce on-track rivalry born from a controversial collision during the 2021 season finale. Both drivers are equally competitive and neither is willing to concede an inch on the track.
A battle of the generations. Javier is a young up-and-comer challenging Cadú's dominance, leading to heated exchanges and intense competition for the top step of the podium.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't about perfection, it's about passion. If you're not willing to risk it all, you're not really racing."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2020 Copa Montana championship in dramatic fashion, overtaking his rival on the final lap of the final race with a daring move that will be forever etched in racing history.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the 2019 Interlagos race, after a mechanical failure sent him spinning into the barrier, costing him valuable championship points and shaking his confidence.
